environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS with a standard nginx ingress controller (ingress-nginx v1.9.4). Service is exposed via ClusterIP with ingress path /api/internal/*. No network policies applied to the namespace. Ingress configured with TLS termination (server-side only) using a Let's Encrypt certificate. No client certificate validation. Pod runs as root with default service account. Inter-service communication happens over plaintext HTTP within the cluster mesh.

config.ingress: ingress-nginx with server-TLS only, no auth-tls annotations
